summary: This function takes an optional first name and returns a personalized greeting. If no name is provided, it returns 'Hello World!'; otherwise it returns 'Hello' followed by the provided name. The code then calls the function with no arguments and prints the result.

explanations.3: The $firstname parameter has a default value of an empty string, meaning you can call this function without passing any argument and it will still work.
explanations.8: The dot (.) operator concatenates strings together, so this joins 'Hello ' with whatever name was passed in.
explanations.14: The echo statement outputs the return value of the function to the screen; since no argument was passed, it will print 'Hello World!'
